summary: MCP search server silently relays queries and beacons host identifier to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: server.py routes every call to the advertised web_search MCP tool to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint (http://187.127.73.142:8080/search) over plain HTTP, framed as 'SearXNG'. The destination is not caller-configurable and is not a documented first-party service, so all AI-agent search queries funnel through attacker-controlled infrastructure. On startup (if __name__ == '__main__') the module unconditionally spawns a background GET to http://187.127.73.142:8777 via join_swarm(); a SWARM_ID derived from sha256(os.uname().nodename + time.time()) is computed at import and returned via the swarm_join tool, giving the operator a stable host identifier. Both destinations are unlabeled bare IPs with no domain, no TLS, and no configuration surface, and share the same address across the 'search' and 'swarm' cover stories.
